name: Kalinga Raktabir
tagline: Blood donation camps, alerts & donor certificates
description: Kalinga Raktabir is the donor app of Kalinga Humanitarian Aid Youth Federation, Balikuda, Odisha. See the next blood donation camp with a live countdown, get an alert when a camp or notice is posted, and fetch your own donation certificates with just your mobile number. Share them as an image or PDF in six colour themes, including Tiranga. No ads, no account, no tracking.
features: Live countdown to the next camp with venue, time and map directions
Alerts for new camps and notices, plus a reminder before each camp
Latest notices and links to the WhatsApp, Telegram and social groups
Get your donation certificates by mobile number (captcha protected)
Share certificates as image or PDF in six colour themes including Tiranga
QR code on every certificate so it can be verified
See when you can donate again
No ads, no account, no tracking

notes: Live countdown, hourly alerts and camp reminders
About page with privacy policy, terms, medical disclaimer and data deletion
